children: New Zealand's central bank said on Wednesday assistant governor Karen Silk will leave the bank in December, after more than four years with the organisation.
Silk will remain in her role until the middle of December and will participate in the December monetary policy decision, the Reserve Bank of New Zealand said in a statement.
